Dispatch local fixers through run-external-agent.sh codex→cursor argv parity, not launch-*-ci.sh

commit_message:
Add ship-pr Phase 4 checks module for local lint-fix loop

Port run-relevant-checks-captured.sh and lint-fix-loop.sh into python/checks.py with injectable runners, dual-mode fix accounting, and OK/STALLED/NEEDS_USER_INPUT/TRANSIENT escalation. Shell out to run-external-agent.sh for codex/cursor fixer dispatch and git-commit.sh for auto-commit parity.
